- **Name**: UBL/CII Electronic Invoice Format Module
- **Description**: Implements multiple e-invoicing standards (UBL 2.0, 2.1, CII/Factur-X, PEPPOL BIS 3.0, XRechnung, EHF3, NLCIUS, Singapore UBL, E-FFF) for Odoo 18.0; generates and parses XML invoices for PEPPOL networks and government portals
